Last updated: September 26, 2025

1. Data Accessed
MinimalLog may access the following data:

• In-app records: Notes, tags, images, and other user input. These records are stored locally on your device.
• Google Sign-In (optional): Your Google account email is used for sign-in identification.
• Google Drive appDataFolder (optional): Access is used only for backup and restore.
• Ads and analytics: Advertising ID (AAID), app usage statistics, and crash or error logs may be processed through Google AdMob or Google Analytics.

2. Data Usage
In-app records are used only to provide save, view, and organization features. Google account information and Drive access are used only for identification and user-requested backup or restore. Advertising and analytics data is used to deliver ads, measure performance, and improve stability.

3. Data Sharing
MinimalLog does not sell or share Google user data with third parties. Information processed by Google AdMob or Google Analytics is handled according to Google’s policies.

4. Storage and Protection
Local data is stored in Android’s sandboxed storage. Backups are stored in your Google Drive appDataFolder and protected by Google authentication and encryption. Network communication uses HTTPS.

5. Retention and Deletion
Local data is removed when you delete the app or reset its data. Google Drive backups can be removed through Google Drive or supported in-app functions. Google retains and deletes advertising and analytics logs according to its policies. Data deletion requests sent to aube.team@gmail.com are processed within 30 days.

6. Your Rights
You may manage or delete local data and backups at any time. Ad personalization and analytics settings can be managed through your Google Account or device settings.

7. Contact
For questions about this policy, contact aube.team@gmail.com.
